parsedVerdict.reasoning: PlaceOrderUseCase.execute does normal application-layer work. It checks the shape of the incoming PlaceOrderRequest (field types and presence), coordinates domain collaborators through ports (StockReservationService.reserve, IdGenerator.next, OrderRepository.save), builds the domain objects (OrderItem, Order) and maps the result to an OrderDto. It has no persistence code (no SQL, ORM or storage calls; it only uses the OrderRepository port), no transport or framework logic (no HTTP request or response handling, status codes or framework decorators), and no real business rules. Quantity validation is left to the OrderItem domain constructor. The 'items must be non-empty' check is close to a domain invariant. Here, though, it reads as validating the request's shape before building domain objects, which belongs in the application layer. No ADR text was provided that says otherwise.
